> hand for one in your library (violating the rule on returning
> cards to the library by explicit card text).

Doesn't Carlotta exchange cards in your hand for library cards in your
_ash heap_ not your library?

>
> However, attempting the same thing with Whispers of the Dead
> wouldn't work, since the template used by WotD doesn't override
> the rule. (Actually, Carlotta's text may just be an oversight -
> I'll run it by the RT).

Since WotD says to 'discard' whereas Carlotta says to 'exchange'.
Imogen also says to 'exchange'.

So basically a card only reverts to its owner while going to an
ash-heap, library, or hand and doesn't get returned if it can somehow
avoid this process (such as through explicit card text). Thus if the
card ends up in someone else's ash heap, library, or hand (e.g.,
Carlotta and Imogen), it stays there until something else happens to
move it back. Is this correct?

Anthony Barker.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
see...@bottom.of.msg wrote:
> Anthony Barker wrote:
> > It goes to its owner ash-heap.
> > > Cards that go into an ash heap, hand, or library always go into
> > > their owner's ash heap, hand, or library. [RTR 970425]
> heeeeey...
> what happens if i trade a vote in my hand to another methuselah via
> succubus club.
> then in their turn they play the vote card, and the vote is not blocked.
> if i now play "delaying tactics" which says return the card to the hand,
> does that mean it goes back to _my_ hand????

No, because card text explicitly overrides that.

Note that Carlotta could exchange the Succubus-traded card in your

hand for one in your library (violating the rule on returning
cards to the library by explicit card text).

However, attempting the same thing with Whispers of the Dead

wouldn't work, since the template used by WotD doesn't override
the rule. (Actually, Carlotta's text may just be an oversight -
I'll run it by the RT).

If that card Carlotta moved to your library is later burned by Dirtly
Little Secrets, then it moves from your Library to the owner's ash
heap (since DLS doesn'toverride the rule).

However, your Predator's Imogen could move the Succubus-traded card
from your hand to your Ash Heap, since she uses an "exchange"
template similar to Caroltta's. Once in your Ash Heap, the card
could be returned to your hand by Carlotta's ability or by Whispers
of the Dead.

In general, you should keep careful track of cards that your trade
from your hand with Succubus Club, so that the Golden Rule is
not violated.

I'll run Carlotta and Imogen by the RT in the hopes of getting
them to "discard" the appropriate card rather than "exchanging"
it. But the text on Delaying Tactics is appropriate, I believe.

OK so far?
